svg.text: The 28 configurations of the generalization study
Blue: the evaluated path. Grey dashed: the calibration figure-eight, drawn at the same scale for reference. Thresholds (C_up = 160, C_down = 70) frozen for every panel.
A. Trajectory family - in-sample (8): one factor moved at a time
B. Held-out paths (4): shapes never used to set the thresholds
C. Workspace regions (4): the whole path translated by +/- 60 mm
D. Contact (4): an exogenous 8 mm sphere, free-to-contact transition
E. Tendon combinations (5): stroke authority removed or rescaled
F. Payload (3): sphere indentation depth sets the contact load
